creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_mist_archive/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python) and Node 24 (v24.12.0 used). render.py runs studio/audio/cli.mjs on score.json; the output parent directory must exist.
patch: Studio audio score, MT19937 seed 6101 (per note [seed, event, layer]). Voices: soft additive pluck (five partials, pick position 0.28) calling E3-E4; paper voice answering each phrase: band-passed noise sweeping 4.2-7.6 kHz with 19 Hz amplitude flutter plus short 5.2-9.5 kHz flicks; triangle drone E2+B2, then A2+E3 from bar 17. Seeded-noise impulse reverb 2.4 s, wet 0.36, folded across the loop boundary.
tuning: E minor pentatonic (E G A B D), tonal center E; A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: Pluck fundamentals E3-E4 (below about 330 Hz); the paper voice lives above 4 kHz and is short, so the 1.6-5 kHz tell register stays at -24.4 dB of total energy. Measured mono energy share (engine bands): 0-100 Hz -9.02 dB, 100-450 Hz -0.81 dB, 450-1600 Hz -14.51 dB, 1600-5000 Hz -24.4 dB, 5000-22050 Hz -22.81 dB.
structure: Six four-bar groups. Bars 1-2 of each group are the plucked call (a, b, a, c, b, c-down-an-octave), bars 3-4 hold the paper answer (a, b, c, a, b, c); bar 4 of each group carries only the drone and the reverb tail, so the enemy tell has rests to cut through. The drone changes from E2+B2 to A2+E3 at bar 17. Bar 24 carries only the drone.
proposal: Tempo, length, loop point and structure are the author's proposal (docs/AUDIO_DESIGN.md, 'Branches proposal'); the project owner chose only the one-sentence brief.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: Notes, drone and reverb tails wrap modulo the loop; frame 0 continues from frame loopEnd - 1.

verification.rebuild: Rendered by the Studio audio engine; render twice gives byte-identical WAV (tools/tests/test_audio_branches.py rebuilds into a scratch directory and compares).
verification.meter: Studio audio engine measure (BS.1770 K-weighted LUFS, 4x oversampled true-peak estimate); pack evidence re-measures with the pinned FFmpeg 6.1.1 ebur128.
verification.scale_check: Every pitched note is inside the declared pentatonic (key.enforce true; the engine raises out_of_scale otherwise).
